source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Stress  Mini DP function by FurMark.
1. Install FurMark
2. Turn off any possible power-saving features on the device.
 -Turn off Screen Saver.
 -Set all Power Options plan to "Never".
3. Turn off any possible wireless activity on the device (such as Bluetooth, wifi ,etc.)
4. Remove the device from any possible cradle or other PC connection
5. Reboot the system before running the tests , or otherwise ensure that there are no other applications running.
6. Run FurMark 30 mins by administer

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No abnormal display or hang up
2. Graphic card after Fumark still can work normally.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: mesa-utils (FurMark user-provided; headless fallback via xvfb)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- FurMark long-run: install + run FurMark (headless: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "xvfb-run -a glmark2 2>&1 | tail -30 2>&1" as a lighter stand-in; real FurMark needs a display + user). Long-running GPU render stress.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL render/score output + stability (no hang/artifact) so the user confirms the GPU survived the long run; the full-length FurMark is user/display driven.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: long GPU render stress raises temperature/power; confirm cooling and user approval.

original_test_intent: Run the approved FurMark workload for 30 minutes on the identified GPU/MiniDP display path and verify by physical observation that no abnormal display or hang occurs and that graphics function remains normal afterward.
original_method: Install the approved FurMark build, record and temporarily adjust the specified power/wireless/cradle/application state, reboot or ensure a clean session, run FurMark as administrator for 30 minutes under safety monitoring, visually observe the display and restore every setting.
manual_activity: The source's core acceptance includes observing the physical MiniDP display for abnormal output throughout/after the FurMark run. An engineer must perform that visual judgment even though the agent can automate workload execution and telemetry.
required_inputs: Approved FurMark installer/version/hash/license and exact render preset/resolution
Observable artifact/hang and post-function criteria plus operator
Thermal/power limits, 30-minute window, abort and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Do not substitute glmark2, Xvfb or any headless workload for FurMark on the physical display path.
Do not run an unknown binary or disable unapproved system/network/power functions.
Continuously enforce approved thermal/power/GPU/display Safety Stops and preserve raw failures.
Restore every changed setting; do not auto-retry after hang, artifact, unsafe telemetry or early termination.
agent_execution_scope: Verify package/configuration and record all pre-test system settings and health.
After plan approval, automate the exact FurMark 30-minute run and synchronized telemetry/log capture.
Restore approved settings, collect post-GPU/display health and organize operator visual evidence without claiming the observation.
engineer_actions: Approve the FurMark package/preset, temporary changes, limits and recovery.
Observe the physical display for artifacts/no signal/hang during and after the run.
Review tool, telemetry and visual evidence and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unacceptable as coverage: glmark2 under Xvfb is a different, lighter, headless workload and removes the physical MiniDP display criterion. The hard-coded SSH shortcuts are also unsuitable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the exact approved FurMark interface/version and documented preset/automation method. Capture full output and do not invent flags or replace the workload.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FurMark, administrator execution, 30 minutes, power/screen-saver/wireless/cradle/application preconditions, reboot-or-clean-session wording and 15/30-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN FURMARK AND HUMAN DISPLAY OBSERVATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Checksum the approved package, snapshot/temporarily apply authorized settings, run the exact 30-minute preset with synchronized GPU temperature/power/clock/error monitoring, keep the physical display under engineer observation, then restore state and perform post-run graphics checks.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact OS, FurMark build, GPU/driver and physical MiniDP display chain.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record tool, driver, firmware and OS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: FurMark vendor documentation plus owner-approved platform limits and display criteria.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic configuration, monitoring and restoration without replacing FurMark or the physical display.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No headless or lighter substitute is allowed; visual display coverage is retained.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Package/preset, display criteria, limits and restore plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Telemetry may be normal while a physical display shows artifacts, so the manual observation remains mandatory.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a different duration/preset and must report that reduced/changed plan accurately; it cannot claim the source 30-minute FurMark coverage if not executed. Package and approval are readiness inputs, while the visual core keeps this MANUAL ONLY.
expected_evidence: Before/after temporary-setting inventory with restoration proof
Full 30-minute FurMark output plus synchronized thermal/power/GPU/display logs
Timestamped operator artifact/hang observation, post-function evidence, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure and criteria consistently require FurMark, a 30-minute stress interval, no display/hang abnormality and normal post-test graphics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The method is clear. Package, preset, thresholds and project settings are readiness inputs, not permanent blockers.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Reject its glmark2/Xvfb substitution and preserve exact FurMark plus physical display coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain its package, safety, setting-restoration and visual controls; reclassify to MANUAL ONLY because abnormal physical display is a core criterion.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates automatable workload/telemetry support from the engineer-owned visual acceptance and verdict.

review_improvement: Eliminates a coverage-regressing substitute, adds reversible environment control and ensures normal telemetry cannot hide visible MiniDP artifacts.
independent_technical_reasoning: The FurMark run and logs are automatable, but the named acceptance signal includes abnormal physical display behavior. Under the locked V3.1 rule that human visual core makes the complete testcase MANUAL ONLY.
